visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black-rimmed glasses and a black tank top sits in a brightly lit indoor room, looking down at his smartphone. (3) The man returns to the frame, speaking to the camera with a skeptical and slightly amused expression while holding his phone. (4) Suddenly, the man is shown wearing the same beige long-nosed mask. He looks into the camera and uses his hand to playfully flick the fabric nose of the mask. (5) The man is back to his normal appearance, resting his chin on his hand with a deadpan expression, continuing his monologue. (6) He is then shown wearing a light blue version of the same mask, highlighting the existence of multiple colors. He points at the mask's nose with a smirk. (7) The video ends with him looking directly at the camera, resting his head on his palm, appearing both tired and sarcastic.
